bullets.text: Google Wallet Expands IDs - **Google Wallet** now supports digital passports from Brazil, Singapore, and Taiwan on Android.
iOS Update Enhances Security - **Apple**'s iOS 26.4.1 automatically enables Stolen Device Protection for some iPhones.
Apple Wallet's Digital ID Grows - **Apple Wallet** now allows age verification using Digital ID for select services.
Apple TV Crime Thriller Returns - **Apple TV**'s acclaimed series **Criminal Record** is back with a new season.
Meta's Solar Power Innovation - **Meta** partners with Overview Energy to beam solar power from space to Earth.
Truecaller Faces Growth Challenges - **Truecaller** experiences slowing growth as competition intensifies in caller ID services.
Apple TV Executive Moves to Amazon - **Apple TV**'s Oliver Jones transitions to lead scripted content at **Amazon**.
Tim Cook to Step Down - **Apple** CEO **Tim Cook** announces his departure, paving the way for John Ternus.
Google's Icon Design Update - **Google** rolls out new gradient icon designs across more apps.
